about: Incorporated in 2001, Riddhi Steel and Tube Ltd manufactures ERW mild steel black, galvanized /pre-galvanized round pipes and square/rectangular hollow sections in Ahmedabad for infrastructure, construction, solar, transmission, agriculture, greenhouse and engineering applications. [1]
